modalities.evidence: Functional magnetic resonance imaging was conducted before and after the intervention
To compute resting state functional connectivity (RSFC)
Temporal changes of HRV during the resting state recording

output.summary: Functional MRI acquired before and after an 8-week heart rate variability biofeedback intervention in healthy subjects, versus a control group playing games, examining resting-state connectivity of the ventral medial prefrontal cortex.
